post.title: Why mattresses are always on sale but never cheap
post.ig:
Why is a mattress always on sale, but never cheap?

In 2025, Sleep Number's cost of sales was 41.0 cents of every sales dollar (a 59.0% gross margin).
Selling it cost more: sales and marketing took 47.1 cents per dollar, and the company posted a $47 million operating loss.
FTC pricing guides say a 'was' price must be one the item was really offered at. In 2025, Mattress Firm settled a California suit over allegedly fake discounts at $40 per online order.

Sources: Sleep Number 2025 Form 10-K, FTC Guides Against Deceptive Pricing (16 CFR 233), Hampton v. Mattress Firm settlement.
